subject: Reminder: Payment Due for March Rent
body: Dear Tenant, This is a friendly reminder that the rent payment for the month of March is due by the 5th. Please ensure that the payment is made on time to avoid any late fees. You can make the payment through our online portal or drop off a check at the leasing office. Let us know if you have any questions or need assistance. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, Property Management Team
